Ontological order Deep ontologies very simplified.

Real case: tools/apps/routing.json names every app, its category and its field tree in one schema — Goddy's rated rows, Raty's words and Wizy's suggestions all speak that same vocabulary, so a new app only declares which words it uses.

Selfcontained Use anywhere, free design. Bugs don't scale.

Real case: apps/demos/dealy-mini.html carries its CSS, its JS and its flove-fields manifest in one file — it opens from a USB stick, a Pages URL or a phone, and a bug is fixed by regenerating that single file.

Private & portable Kept in your device.

Real case: Sensy keeps your answers in localStorage and exports them as sensy-portrait.json; the file stays on the device until you press Share, and the same JSON imports into Appy on any other device.

La canalización de la distro (pipeline)How the distro is built (pipeline)

01 CommitsCommits

Todo empieza en un commit: cada cambio que toca apps/ se versiona, y el hook post-commit apunta las rutas en tools/jsony-state.json para que jsony las revise.Everything starts in a commit: every change touching apps/ is versioned, and the post-commit hook queues the paths in tools/jsony-state.json so jsony can review them.

02 updaty

updaty es una sola escalera: en nivel 3 publica la web; en nivel 4 reconstruye paquetes, regenera sw.js, sincroniza el vocabulario y publica; en nivel 5 los subdominios.updaty is one ladder: level 3 publishes the site; level 4 rebuilds packages, regenerates sw.js, syncs the vocabulary and publishes; level 5 the subdomains.

03 DescargaDownload

flove-localhost.zip viaja desde flove.org y también queda adjunto a GitHub Releases; el APK/AAB se publica en Releases y el TWA se reconstruye solo cuando cambia el manifest.flove-localhost.zip travels from flove.org and is attached to GitHub Releases too; the APK/AAB ships in Releases, and the TWA rebuilds only when the manifest changes.

04 routing.json

Cada app embebe su manifiesto flove-fields; tools/apps/v1/extract-fields.py --apply los recoge en tools/apps/routing.json (esquema flove-routing/3: apps, árbol de campos y categoría). --check bloquea cualquier deriva.Each app embeds its own flove-fields manifest; tools/apps/v1/extract-fields.py --apply gathers them into tools/apps/routing.json (schema flove-routing/3: apps, field tree and category). --check blocks any drift.

05 jsony

El hook post-commit encola las rutas que tocan apps/; jsony_check.py --changed compara manifiestos, routing y el snapshot APP_ROUTING de Appy, y deja la deriva en tools/jsony-pending.{md,json} para revisar. Nunca edita el backbone en silencio.The post-commit hook queues the paths touching apps/; jsony_check.py --changed compares manifests, routing and Appy's APP_ROUTING snapshot, and leaves any drift in tools/jsony-pending.{md,json} for review. It never edits the backbone silently.

De nota de voz a perfil webFrom voice note to web profile

Un bot de Telegram recoge notas de voz, un grupo humano modera, y todo lo aprobado acaba como MP3 en Cloudflare R2 con su entrada en risa.json; la web lee el feed, lo anida y enriquece su entorno para reproducirlo en diversas listas (tags y perfil) y poder contestar a el, con un clip nuevo o solapado al citado.A Telegram bot collects voice notes, a human group moderates, and everything approved ends up as an MP3 on Cloudflare R2 with its entry in risa.json; the web reads the feed, nests it and enriches its surroundings to play it in several lists (tags and profile) and to reply to it — with a new clip or one overlapped on the quoted one.

Las piezasThe pieces

  1. Repositorio público — código, feed risa.json y la web, todo en un solo repo.Public repository — code, the risa.json feed and the web, all in a single repo.
  2. Bot de Telegram — @BotFather te da el token y crea el bot.Telegram bot — @BotFather gives you the token and creates the bot.
  3. Canal + grupo de moderación — el canal publica; un grupo privado aprueba o rechaza.Channel + moderation group — the channel publishes; a private group approves or rejects.
  4. Cloudflare R2 — almacenamiento gratuito (10 GB) para los audios, con URL pública.Cloudflare R2 — free storage (10 GB) for the audios, with a public URL.
  5. GitHub Actions — un cron llama al bot cada 5–10 minutos para vaciar la cola.GitHub Actions — a cron calls the bot every 5–10 minutes to drain the queue.

Rol: asiste a montar el proyecto «mi proyecto», inspirándote en el proyecto libre github.com/floveorg/risa.

- Bot: @TuBot — cron Actions 5–10 min

- Campos por pieza: título · etiquetas · autor.

Requisitos (release completa): piezas ≤ 1 min · ≤ 10 MB · máx. 5 en cola y 5 al día · CC BY-SA 4.0 («Enviar = consentir», tag «libre») · página de autor #/u/<key> con feed propio · comandos de solo lectura /me · /stats · /profile · /status · /queue · /latest · /now · /today · /since · /random · /trending · /play · etiquetas → chips · búsqueda · favoritos (filtro local) · entrada por deep link + QR · repo dedicado con Pages · feed risa.json newest-first.

Pasos:
1. Clona el repo de referencia; estudia bot/, index.html, risa.json y .github/workflows.
2. Pide y valida los secretos (BOT_TOKEN, CHANNEL_ID, MOD_GROUP_ID, credenciales R2) antes de usarlos.
3. Configura GitHub Actions como cron que llame a getUpdates cada 5–10 minutos.
4. Monta el feed risa.json y la web en GitHub Pages.
5. Verifica de punta a punta con una prueba real de audio · vídeo.

Permisos: leer/escribir el repo del proyecto, instalar dependencias de Node, desplegar Pages y Actions. Nada fuera del repo; confirma antes de crear credenciales.

Restricciones: sin servidor ni base de datos propios; piezas gratuitas (R2, Pages, Actions); respeta la privacidad (nunca guardar ids de Telegram en claro). Responde en español.

Data Depth · five levels

One ladder for every text skill. texty3 and translaty3 run levels 1–3 and stop; the number is also the stop point. Names are level 3, JSON values level 4, and contracts stay read-only at 5.

LevelNameWhat it coversCommands
1SurfaceEvery string the reader sees: headings, prose, buttons, hints, empty and error states, text read aloud.texty1 · translaty1
2LabelsMetadata and field labels: <title>, description, aria-label, title, placeholder, field labels, data-aria-* / data-ph-*, i18n display values.texty2 · translaty2
3NamesInternal names: classes, ids, JS identifiers, data and i18n keys. Rename or translate their display values; never the keys.texty3 · translaty3
4DataDisplay values inside manifests and envelopes: flove-fields, routing descriptions and tags, flove-portrait values, i18n tables. Keys stay untouched.texty4 · translaty4
5ContractsCanonical identifiers and contracts: routing.json, flove-fields, the export schema, routes and enum names. Read-only for text and translation.texty5 · translaty5

Skills: texty · translaty. Translaty keeps its own engine and follows the same 1–5 stop points. Brandy has its own five stages: brandy4 runs stages 1–4.

Base de datos de apps · cinco stagesApp database · five stages

La base de datos es para las apps y las sys apps que las sirven, no para tareas de desarrollo. Cada etapa usa una de las cinco palabras canónicas: seed, infant, mature, grown, full. Toca una tarjeta para abrir su contenido.The database is for apps and the sys apps that serve them, not for development tasks. Each stage uses one of the five canonical words: seed, infant, mature, grown, full. Click a card to open its content.

seed · GuardarSave

Cada app guarda su propio estado en localStorage; los JSON canónicos viven en git y el service worker los precachea. Es el punto de partida y el modo de reserva cuando no hay nodo.Each app saves its own state in localStorage; canonical JSON lives in git and the service worker precaches it. This is the starting point and the fallback when there is no node.

infant · EnlazarBridge

risa.json manda: renderiza primero. Después, y solo después, una llamada opcional a flove.json añade el enlace al perfil al reclamar una palabra y activa Lovy ya autenticado. Timeout de 4 s, solo claves conocidas, fallo silencioso: si da 404 la web queda igual. La réplica alojada (Turso/libSQL) da el mismo perfil en dos dispositivos con el nodo apagado.risa.json rules: it renders first. Only then an optional flove.json call adds the profile link when a word is claimed and activates an already-authenticated Lovy. 4 s timeout, known keys only, fail-silent: on 404 the site looks the same. A hosted replica (Turso/libSQL) gives the same profile on two devices with the node off.

rusqlite + FTS5 en el nodo local. El modelo mínimo es el flove-profile que ya exporta apps/appy/index.html: handle, presence, stage, trust, identities, self, risa, appsPlayed, network, posts, visibility. Una sola fila profiles para todas las apps; el JSON en git manda y SQLite es proyección con SHA.rusqlite + FTS5 in the local node. The minimal model is the flove-profile already exported by apps/appy/index.html: handle, presence, stage, trust, identities, self, risa, appsPlayed, network, posts, visibility. One profiles row for every app; git JSON rules and SQLite is a SHA projection.

La activación la decide la pestaña Privacidad de Appy, sin Sety aparte: visibility gobierna los selectores, claims desbloquea publicar, y risa, stage y plays ya funcionan con la fila. Sin nodo, todo sigue en seed.Appy's Privacy tab owns activation, with no separate Sety: visibility drives the selects, claims unlocks publishing, and risa, stage and plays already work from the row. With no node, everything stays in seed.

Privacidad activa también la visibilidad de grupo, la copia y la rotación; MyNet toma sus puertas de claims; Actividad lee anillos, etapa y presencia de la fila. Blogy y MyFamily escriben en plays, y Browsy y Authy entregan claims.Privacy also drives group visibility, backup and rotation; MyNet takes its gates from claims; Activity reads rings, stage and presence from the row. Blogy and MyFamily write plays, and Browsy and Authy hand off claims.

full · FederarFederate

Varios nodos, sin autoridad central. Los stages seed–grown siguen siendo el modo offline de cada dispositivo. El perfil y sus edges se verifican en otro nodo por firma + SHA; los paquetes se intercambian con manifiesto firmado. Aquí —y solo aquí— Meilisearch puede volver como índice derivado de descubrimiento, nunca como fuente.Several nodes, no central authority. Stages seed–grown remain each device's offline mode. The profile and its edges verify on another node by signature + SHA; packages travel with a signed manifest. Here —and only here— Meilisearch may return as a derived discovery index, never as a source.

Updaty · five release levels

/updatyN runs levels 1 → N and stops; with no number the level is picked from the tree and the request. Skill: updaty.

LevelNameWhat it runsStops before
1GateRead-only sweep: distro, routing, jsony, a11y, depth/worldview drift. Reports warnings and stops on a hard error.any write
2CommitStages the named source paths only and commits them.push
3Publish mainPushes and publishes only the paths that changed.rebuilt artifacts
4Heavy + publishAdds the sync, sw.js, the zip and local/Gitea GC, then publishes once.subdomains
5Full releaseAdds the subdomains; the APK is a separate updaty-apk run.—

Auto-pick: dirty tree → 1 · clean + commit → 2 · publish → 3 · upgrade → 4 · full release → 5. The run reports the level used and the next one.

V3 Navegador & V4 P2P

Browsy v3, la extensión que da identidad y confianza, y Nety v4, Red P2P y computación distribuida.Browsy v3, the extension that gives identity and trust, and Nety v4, a P2P network and distributed computing.

Browsy v3 · características técnicasBrowsy v3 · technical features

  • MV3 con polyfill V2 para Firefox — service worker en background y content scripts como puente; el frontend vive en central, Browsy es solo el cerebro de confianza.MV3 with a V2 polyfill for Firefox — background service worker and content scripts as the bridge; the frontend lives in central, Browsy is only the trust brain.
  • content.js = bridge API — expone identidad + confianza a la página solo cuando el dominio es flove.org; el puente responde en <100 ms.content.js = bridge API — exposes identity + trust to the page only when the domain is flove.org; the bridge answers in <100 ms.
  • background.js — genera claves ed25519 (Web Crypto, tweetnacl como fallback), menús de contexto, badge y mirror de ajustes.background.js — generates ed25519 keys (Web Crypto, tweetnacl as a fallback), context menus, badge and settings mirror.
  • Storage — chrome.storage.local para el núcleo y chrome.storage.sync para ajustes; sync unidireccional Browsy → central.Storage — chrome.storage.local for the core and chrome.storage.sync for settings; one-way sync Browsy → central.
  • F2F — verificación QR + challenge; cadenas de confianza de ~100 avales en <2 s.F2F — QR verification + challenge; trust chains of ~100 avals in <2 s.
  • Enchufable — lib/crypto.js y lib/store.js son los puntos que nety reutilizará.Plug-in ready — lib/crypto.js and lib/store.js are the points nety will reuse.

Nety v4 · características técnicasNety v4 · technical features

  • Rust (edition 2021) — workspace de 16 crates de red + 2 de test; daemon libp2p y CLI por separado.Rust (edition 2021) — workspace of 16 network crates + 2 test ones; libp2p daemon and CLI separately.
  • libp2p 0.54 — TCP + Noise + Yamux, DHT Kademlia, Gossipsub, Identify y Ping.libp2p 0.54 — TCP + Noise + Yamux, Kademlia DHT, Gossipsub, Identify and Ping.
  • Runner — Wasmtime 24 (WASI preview 1) para imágenes WASM en slots de 1 vCPU / 1 GiB RAM / 8 GiB disco.Runner — Wasmtime 24 (WASI preview 1) for WASM images in slots of 1 vCPU / 1 GiB RAM / 8 GiB disk.
  • Storage en cascada — LocalBackend → IPFS (Kubo) → S3 (MinIO) → HybridBackend.Cascading storage — LocalBackend → IPFS (Kubo) → S3 (MinIO) → HybridBackend.
  • Crypto — ed25519 + ChaCha20-Poly1305 + argon2id; identidad con keystore cifrado.Crypto — ed25519 + ChaCha20-Poly1305 + argon2id; identity with an encrypted keystore.
  • Reputación — CRDT eventualmente consistente y Web of Trust de 2º orden.Reputation — eventually-consistent CRDT and 2nd-order Web of Trust.
  • Estado actual — daemon y gateway aún no se comunican (sin bootstrap/mDNS); el gateway usa InMemoryStore y SocialStore está creado pero sin enlazar.Current state — daemon and gateway do not talk yet (no bootstrap/mDNS); the gateway uses InMemoryStore and SocialStore exists but is not wired.

  • Audios o vídeos de máx. 1 min y 10 MBAudio or video of max 1 min and 10 MB

  • Licencia CC BY-SA 4.0 en cada pieza, con aviso «Enviar = consentir» y tag por defecto «libre»CC BY-SA 4.0 licence on every piece, with a "Sending = consenting" notice and the default tag "libre"
  • Página de autor automática por persona: #/u/<key> con su propio feed, y el bot regala el enlace en el aviso de publicación (funciona con solo nombre público)Automatic author page per person: #/u/<key> with its own feed, and the bot shares the link in the publication notice (it works with just a public name)
  • Comandos de consulta en el bot, todos de solo lectura y reproducción: /me · /stats · /profile · /status · /queue · /latest · /now · /today · /since · /random · /trending · /playQuery commands in the bot, all read & play only: /me · /stats · /profile · /status · /queue · /latest · /now · /today · /since · /random · /trending · /play
  • Etiquetas enriquecidas hasta la web: chips filtrables, búsqueda y favoritos ❤️/⭐ como filtro local del mismo feedTags enriched up to the web: filterable chips, search and ❤️/⭐ favourites as a local filter of the same feed
  • Entrada por deep link y QR desde la webDeep-link and QR entry from the web
  • Repo dedicado con su propio GitHub Pages, con feed newest-firstDedicated repo with its own GitHub Pages, feed newest-first
